correctness.rationale: For a nondegenerate Euclidean d-simplex d>=3, the barycentric lower bounds on T intersect (T+z) give exact normalized covariogram (1-q(z))_+^d, where q=max over proper subset gradient sums. Integrating radially gives initial polynomial P until inradius a=1/max norm L. Below the minimum of submaximal normal activation and maximal-cap overlap radius, all active caps are disjoint; inside each cap the maximizing functional is q, giving exact m equal cap corrections with sign (-1)^{d+1}. Spherical cross-section integration gives the beta coefficient and exponent (3d+1)/2; for d=3 independent symbolic integration matches pi*(r-a)^5*(a+5r)/(60a^3). Repeated maximal normals, antipodes and infinite threshold conventions are addressed, and nothing is claimed after r1.
